content:
Carla Nguyen: @channel INCIDENT: us-east-1 serving cluster - repeated pod evictions (DiskPressure) causing runtime crashes and CUDA failures. Observed: model-serving pods restart loop, some show "OOMKilled" after eviction. Page: @Anil (oncall)

incident-bot: [ALERT] 1717838400 - NodeGroup-us-east-1a high ephemeral storage usage (>90%) -> PodEviction events x24 in last 5m

Anil Rao: I'm on it. Pulling kubectl events + node usage now.

Maya Kim: Noted customer-facing errors: increased 500s on the hosted API; some requests hitting fallback model (slower). Counting impacted customers... will update.

Tom Becker: From logs, when the pod is reattached it fails with CUDA 'cuCtxCreate' errors. Suspect model cache write filling /var/lib/kserve (emptyDir) then eviction -> corrupted cache on restart.

Anil Rao: Confirmed. kubectl describe node ip-10-0-1-45 shows "DiskPressure: Only 600MB available" and multiple Eviction events referencing /var/lib/model-cache.

Anil Rao: Immediate mitigation proposal:
- cordon node ip-10-0-1-45
- drain node with --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
- scale down model prefetchers via feature-flag for hosted runtime (disable aggressive caching)
- restart affected runtime pods after cache purge

Carla Nguyen: do it. Notify customers about degraded performance in status page.

Anil Rao: Running:
```sh
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-1-45
kubectl drain ip-10-0-1-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# remove model cache dir on node
ssh ubuntu@ip-10-0-1-45 'sudo rm -rf /var/lib/model-cache/*'
``` 

ops-bot: drain started (eta 45s), evicted 14 pods.

Maya Kim: Reporting impact: ~12 hosted customers impacted; two mid-market customers see latency >2x; no Dedicated customers affected (different node pool). Posting to status.redwood.ai now. :frowning:

Tom Becker: After purge, restarted runtime pods. Some instances still fail with corrupted cache on startup; rolling restart to clear state.

Anil Rao: Also toggled feature-flag to disable aggressive prefetch (runtime.cache.prefetch=false) for hosted cluster to stop refilling while we triage.

Carla Nguyen: Good. We should also temporarily limit per-pod emptyDir usage. Can we patch the StatefulSet to add emptyDir.sizeLimit? If not available, set an admission controller? Short term maybe set a hostPath bind to larger disk or move caches to PVC.

Tom Becker: Kubernetes emptyDir sizeLimit requires ephemeral-storage quota configured on nodes + kubelet support. For immediate relief I added a DaemonSet job to clear older model shards older than 24h in /var/lib/model-cache.

Anil Rao: Nodes in the pool show freed space, starting to schedule pods elsewhere. Latency dropping back toward baseline but still noisy. 

Maya Kim: Status page updated: "Partial degradation - API latency increased for hosted models in us-east-1. Mitigation in progress." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2024-06-07-disk-pressure

Carla Nguyen: Assign followups: 
- eng-runtime to add eviction-aware cache cleanup (Tom)
- infra to increase ephemeral storage pool and add disk-pressure alert earlier (SRE)
- product to assess customers to contact for SLA implications (Maya)

Tom Becker: Creating PR for runtime to switch to PVC-backed model cache with bounded cleanup and fallback to smaller model if disk pressure detected.

Anil Rao: Handing off to next on-call in 30m: @Maya, I'll leave notes in the incident channel. Current status: node drained, caching disabled, restart complete, residual errors ~2% of requests. Will keep monitoring.

Maya Kim: Taking over. I'll watch metrics and coordinate postmortem. Posting runbook updates now.

Carla Nguyen: Thanks team. We'll do a short postmortem and add proactive alerts for ephemeral storage >70% and per-pod ephemeral storage usage. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident ended at 1717840200 (mitigation stable). Created incident ticket INC-2024-178 in Jira.

Maya Kim: Logged customers impacted in the ticket; follow-up call scheduled 3pm PT today.

Carla Nguyen: Closing thread for now. Save outputs/log snippets to the incident ticket. We'll meet tomorrow for RCA.
